reviews.title: Ένα πραγματικά καταπληκτικό παιχνίδι!
reviews.text:
Αυτό το παιχνίδι ήταν σημαντικά καλύτερο από οποιοδήποτε άλλο έχω παίξει. Όλα τα στοιχεία που περιλαμβάνει είναι, εκπληκτικά, τελειοποιημένα με θαυμάσιο τρόπο.

Το gameplay είναι εξαιρετικό, το στυλ είναι μοναδικό και η ιστορία είναι ενδιαφέρουσα. Η εξέλιξη, ωστόσο, είναι αυτό που ξεχωρίζει περισσότερο — οι προκλήσεις είναι πραγματικά συναρπαστικές και η εξέλιξη είναι ομαλή. Όλα αυτά το κάνουν να φαίνεται τόσο άψογο...

Και τέλος, στους ταλαντούχους ανθρώπους που βοήθησαν στην ανάπτυξη του παιχνιδιού, σας ενθαρρύνω θερμά να συνεχίσετε να εργάζεστε με την ίδια (ή ακόμα μεγαλύτερη) αφοσίωση. Είστε πραγματικά οι καλύτεροι!

reviews.title: Starts cool...
reviews.text:
Has an amazing first hour, the art is beautiful and there's new stuff all the time.
But, for every new thing you get, the time between each is made more and more exponential. Each boss fight is so gimmicky and strong you need an excessive amount of force and the one viable strategy to get through.
It doesn't take a "strong will" to do the later parts, it takes a complete numbness for how terrible it is to glean small flecks of fun.

Play it, but stop playing it once it gets on your nerves. It will only get worse.

reviews.title: Perfect ♥︎
reviews.text:
This is the perfect RPG. By It has a perfect balance between challenge and strategy that makes it difficult yet fun! Stone Story has a deceptively complex combat system. It looks fairly simple when you start, but later in the game your strategic skills are put to the test. In late game you are required to meticulously plan your weapon load-out according to the level, forcing you to memorize and learn from your mistakes. Don’t be fooled. This is a game of intricate strategy, and not for the weak minded.

reviews.title: As greedy as the others
reviews.text:
I’m unsure why the top reviews for this app hail it as some sort of shining example of consumer-friendly monetization when it is truly just like the rest of the games on the App Store at the moment. What you have is an extremely linear “RPG” that requires little to no conscious thought, and offers even less in terms of gameplay and build expression. By the end of your first hour on the game, it will be giving you advertisements and pop-ups for “Limited Time equipment” which is just Pay-to-Win gear that will progress you through the story much quicker than otherwise. The grind of the game quickly became a slog, the story wasn’t interesting or fleshed out, and the equipment and build aspect is shallow and linear. It’s another Monetization System with a game attached.

So, in other words, this game is no different than the thousands of “idle” games out there. I have no clue why it gets critical acclaim from the top reviews when it suffers from the very faults that they quote as being issues in other games.
